edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner to gate transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates transfernewun.
onlyOwner gates clearCNDAO.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Caller invokes transfer.
Caller invokes approve.
Caller invokes approveAndCall.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] from caller-controlled values.
Caller (spender) invokes transferFrom.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
clearCNDAO assigns the local _owner from msg.sender.
The caller-derived local address receives the whole contract balance.
clearCNDAO executes the ETH transfer operation.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into the caller-supplied spender contract after mutating allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transferFrom silently sets newun = to when newun is still address(0).
The 'to' parameter becomes the persistent blacklist address newun.
transferFrom adjusts balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom adjusts the caller allowance.
transferFrom contains the unguarded newun assignment operation.
transfer adjusts balances of sender and recipient.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for balance decrement.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for balance increment.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for balance increment.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and the zero-address balance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfernewun writes the newun state variable.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner assignment.
_newun parameter flows into the newun assignment.
to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
from parameter is the debit source of transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit target of transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
spender parameter is the external callback target of approveAndCall.

data parameter is forwarded verbatim to receiveApproval.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve.
